name: t0msilver-skills
description: Agent skills for shipping changes you didn't write line by line: which tests are worth keeping, what a change could break, a second agent that verifies a PR, docs checked against the code, and prose without meta-commentary.

plugins.name: owner-workflow
plugins.description: How agents work for an owner who decides intent and delegates the rest: the owner's charter, cards that ask before code, a change's blast radius, a second agent that verifies it, repeated corrections turned into checks, and a weekly debt review.

plugins.name: cli-delegation
plugins.description: Cross-vendor review of a finished change that runs while the author finishes, and read-only repo exploration to fastcontext.

plugins.name: vendored
plugins.description: Pristine copies of third-party skills, vendored from their upstream repositories by scripts/vendor-skills.sh. Each directory keeps its upstream LICENSE and a .vendored stamp naming the repo, path, and pinned commit; fixes go upstream, never into this repo.

plugins.name: unnarrate
plugins.description: Remove self-narrating meta-commentary from UI copy, docs, code comments, and PR text — text that describes the artifact it lives in or restates what the reader already sees. First-party companion to the vendored unslop skill: unnarrate deletes what shouldn't exist, unslop fixes how the rest sounds.

plugins.name: docs-review
plugins.description: Write, edit or review a project's user docs: every claim checked against the code, one home per fact, one sentence per behaviour, and a hard trim. Companion to unnarrate and unslop, which handle how the sentences read.

plugins.name: one-term
plugins.description: One behaviour, one term: each thing keeps one term in docs, UI copy, PRs and replies, a sentence that must repeat is copied word for word, and a term changes only for a different thing, a different context or a stated reason.

plugins.name: test-audit
plugins.description: Decide which tests are worth having: a gate for every new test, and an audit workflow for deleting tests that mirror the code, test mocks, duplicate stronger coverage, or keep test-only production code alive.

plugins.name: blast-radius
plugins.description: Before a PR is ready, write what the change could break beyond its diff, per platform and visually, the one fact it is safe because of, and the cheapest proof for each risk with how far that proof got. The output is the PR body's Blast radius section.

plugins.name: verify
plugins.description: A second agent, not the author, checks a PR before merge: reads the diff and its Blast radius section, gathers evidence risk by risk, looks at every screenshot itself, baselines bug fixes on main, argues against its own verdict, and posts VERIFIED, NOT VERIFIED or INCONCLUSIVE with its scope. Pairs with blast-radius.

plugins.name: orchestrate-sessions
plugins.description: Run one Claude Code desktop session as the orchestrator and scheduler for many parallel sessions on a repo: one chip per issue, slots on a scarce shared resource, merges that keep main green, archiving finished sessions, and the owner's decisions on Starbridge cards. Three skills: orchestrate-sessions, merge-queue, scarce-resource.

plugins.name: quota
plugins.description: Read model usage windows with `quota` and schedule reviews around them: which vendor spends which window, a queue that keeps every Codex 5-hour window busy, and Codex reset credits spent only once the weekly limit is gone.

plugins.name: remote-control-server
plugins.description: Run persistent per-repo `claude remote-control` servers under user systemd so they survive reboots and stay reachable from claude.ai/code. Setup runs via the bundled install script, not automatically.
